news.title: Alex Tuch gets winner against former team and Dylan Strome scores twice, as Capitals beat Sabres 4-3
news.ruTitle: Алекс Тач одержал победу над бывшей командой, а Дилан Стром забил дважды, когда «Кэпиталз» обыграли «Сэйбрз» со счетом 4–3.
news.description: — Alex Tuch scored two goals, including the winner in overtime, to lead the Washington Capitals to a win over the Buffalo Sabres, 4-3 on Saturday night.

news.title: Kochetkov makes 24 saves to help the Hurricanes beat the Blues 4-0
news.ruTitle: Кочетков сделал 24 сейва и помог "Харрикейнз" обыграть "Блюз" со счетом 4-0.
news.description: — Pyotr Kochetkov made 24 saves for his first shutout of the season and 12th in the NHL in the Carolina Hurricanes' 4-0 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.

news.title: Brett Pesce scores go-ahead goal as Devils beat Kings 3-1 for 3rd straight win
news.ruTitle: Бретт Пеше забивает гол, когда «Девилз» обыграли «Кингз» со счетом 3:1 и одержали третью победу подряд
news.description: — Brett Pesce scored the go-ahead goal and Jake Allen made 12 saves as the New Jersey Devils beat the Los Angeles Kings 3-1 on Saturday for their third straight win.

news.title: Leo Carlsson, offered by Flyers, burns Philly in Ducks' win

news.description: Leo Carlsson showed what the Flyers missed out on after scoring and assisting on the game-winner in the Ducks' 5-4 win.

news.title: Leo Carlsson rallies the Ducks to a 5-4 victory over the Flyers
news.ruTitle: Лео Карлссон привел «Дакс» к победе над «Флайерз» со счетом 5–4.
news.description: — Leo Carlsson scored a goal and set up the game-winner against the team that tried to sign him away from Anaheim last summer, as the Ducks overcame a two-goal deficit to beat the Philadelphia Flyers 5-4 on Saturday.
